name: manual_ebe2c3
claim: Promoting a personal-account repo (diazMelgarejo/<repo>) to 'canonical under oramasys' is done by fast-forward-pushing the oramasys GitHub fork's own main branch directly to the desired commit -- not by merging a PR from the personal repo into oramasys, and not by GitHub's repo-transfer feature. The personal repo and any open PRs against it are left untouched unless explicitly told to close/merge them.

decisions.notes: Confirmed on Claude-Desktop-LLM: oramasys/Claude-Desktop-LLM already existed as a GitHub fork of diazMelgarejo/Claude-Desktop-LLM, and its main had already been fast-forward-pushed directly to the working branch tip by a prior session -- bypassing a PR merge into the stale personal-repo main entirely. Confirmed via AskUserQuestion this was the intended pattern (oramasys fork = new canonical, personal repo left alone) rather than a full repo-transfer or a merge-then-mirror.
